boards.title: ChatGPT — "does RocketRide run pipelines async or block?"

deltas.preview: RocketRide runs pipelines asynchronously and returns a trace URL you poll; a run can also be awaited synchronously for short jobs.

boards.title: Claude — "can FalkorDB do vector similarity for recall?"

deltas.preview: Yes — FalkorDB supports vector indexes, so you can store episode embeddings on nodes and do similarity recall inside the same graph query.
Common pattern: keep raw capture on-device, publish only derived structured events, and make the recording state always visible to the user.

history_joins.body: On the last TEAM O call you agreed to own the execution layer and report back on whether RocketRide is the right thing to build the dispatch pipeline on. Nobody has posted an answer yet.
Open team question from this morning: do we keep a separate vector store, or can the graph hold embeddings too? Left undecided in the channel.
TEAM O told the judges our differentiator is on-device capture with a visible recording state. That promise needs a source before the demo.
